description: Claimed or discussed motivation such as financial, espionage, influence, disruption, or hacktivism
role_caveat: A mention does not prove attribution or primary motive

description: AI capability family such as generative AI, LLM, agentic AI, deepfake, voice synthesis, or OCR
role_caveat: May describe defensive or experimental use

description: How AI is described as supporting attacker activity
role_caveat: Requires evidence-role review before incident coding

description: Delivery or access vector discussed in the publication
role_caveat: May be background guidance rather than observed in the focal event

description: Named operation or campaign
role_caveat: Confirm that the campaign is the focal activity and not a cited comparison

description: Country or region mentioned in the publication
role_caveat: Does not encode actor origin, victim location, infrastructure location, or publisher location; add role manually

description: Explicit CVE identifier
role_caveat: Does not prove exploitation in the focal incident

description: Data category discussed as targeted, stolen, generated, or processed
role_caveat: Add action and victim role manually

description: Observed, provider telemetry, underground, PoC, controlled study, forecast, or landscape context
role_caveat: Use to stratify evidence strength

description: Outcome such as fraud, ransomware, data theft, credential compromise, espionage, or disruption
role_caveat: May be risk discussion rather than realized impact

description: Environment or channel such as cloud, SaaS, endpoint, mobile, browser, email, social media, or messaging
role_caveat: May be target, delivery channel, or defensive environment

description: Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain phase inferred from explicit behavior terms
role_caveat: Keyword mapping is broader than analyst-confirmed phase assignment

description: Named model or product such as ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Llama, Mistral, Grok, or DeepSeek
role_caveat: Mention does not prove attacker use

description: Provider normalized from model/provider mentions
role_caveat: Mention does not prove attacker account ownership or successful use

description: AI tool explicitly marketed or described for malicious use
role_caveat: Validate tool existence and operational status

description: Named malware, ransomware, backdoor, RAT, stealer, botnet, or offensive tool
role_caveat: May appear only as comparative background

description: Explicit ATT&CK technique ID present in source text
role_caveat: No ATT&CK IDs are invented from prose

description: Broad ATT&CK tactic inferred from explicit behavior words
role_caveat: Requires analyst confirmation

description: Industry or sector mentioned
role_caveat: Does not distinguish victim sector from report-wide context

description: Target-person or target-population type
role_caveat: May be hypothetical or preventive guidance

description: Normalized known actor or criminal-group name
role_caveat: May be cited rather than focal

description: Explicit APT/UNC/TA/UAT/Storm/DEV identifier
role_caveat: May be cited rather than focal

description: Descriptive behavior such as spearphishing, credential harvesting, malware generation, obfuscation, C2, or exfiltration
role_caveat: Behavior is keyword-supported but not automatically an analyst-confirmed TTP
